en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a festive public event in a historic European city. The scene features a medieval-style gate or archway, elaborately decorated buildings with stepped gables, flags, banners, and a large crowd. There are people in historical costumes, including knights on horseback and onlookers in period dress. The image captures a parade or re-enactment with a festive atmosphere.
